name: architecture-update
purpose: Insert or append scoped architecture decisions, preserving existing text and refreshing shadow section links.
pre_prompt: Read the current architecture index and target section. Declare architecture.md in the frozen task. Supply architecture_revision.expected_sha256 from this preparation, NOT the top-level skill sha256. Source edits can refresh architecture metadata: prepare again after intervening edits. Use concrete file links and brief prose; never replace the whole document.
post_prompt: Verify the fresh receipt and updated section IDs. The edit invalidates prior tests; run frozen tests and the completion gate. A stale revision requires fresh preparation, reviewing the target section and retrying the insertion. An out-of-scope edit requires a scoped replan.

expected_sha256.description: Current architecture document hash from architecture_revision.expected_sha256 in prepare. Empty only for a missing document. Prepare again after source edits; do not use the top-level skill sha256.
